verdict.reason: The tender is for a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solution where AI/ML is a mandatory feature for threat detection, not a standalone AI/ML development or training platform.

evidence.quote: RFP for Supply, Implementation, Configuration, Integration, Maintenance & Management of Data Loss Prevention Solution, Software Licenses and Email Protector Appliances of ForcePoint

The technologies/solution proposed under this project should have in-built AI/ & ML capabilities that significantly enhance the solution’s ability to detect, prevent and respond to modern day cyber security threats.

The solution shall be capable of monitoring and enforcing DLP policies on interactions with Generative AI applications and services, including public AI platforms, enterprise AI assistants and Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces.

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply, implementation, and maintenance of ForcePoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solution, software licenses, and Email Protector appliances.

evidence.quote: The Bank intends to on-board vendor for Supply, Installation, Integration and Support of 12 Numbers of Data Center Class WAN Routers for a period of 5 years

Broad Scope of Work/Activities to be covered in the RFP is as detailed below. 1. The bidder shall complete the implementation of the routers and integration with the Bank's SIEM, NBAD, NMS, NCCM tools etc.
The Bidder should have supplied and installed the router/firewall/SDWAN with minimum 50 Gbps throughput (not necessarily the same model) in BFSI in India during last three years
